title: 第981章 寒冥山第980章 冥风鸟
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
没多久，阿四已然领着二人行至朝阳殿殿门前，躬身低声道：“我家公子就在殿内，两位师姐，请。”
阿四做出一个请的手势，自己却没有进去。
上官灼华微微颔首，踏步踏入了殿内。
林潜早已等候多时。
在上官灼华来到朝阳峰山下时，林潜便通过传讯，得知了上官灼华到来的消息。
殿内，林潜正静坐调息，听到了脚步声，睁眼望向了门口。
一抹明艳如火的红袍身影踏步而入，身姿绰约、气质绝尘。
看清来人，林潜站了起来，露出一丝微笑，抱拳说道：“上官师姐，别来无恙！”
上官灼华抬眸望向林潜，神色一愣，心中却极为震惊。
只见短短一年多未见，林潜周身气息愈发深邃、强大，并且身上散发出真丹境中期的修为。
“林师弟的修为竟然提升这么快，简直是妖孽！”上官灼华心中惊叹。
她当初从真丹境初期突破到中期，可是足足用了六七年的时间，这还是她资源无忧的情况下。
可这位林师弟，才短短一年多时间里，就由真丹境初期突破到真丹境中期。
“林师弟的天赋、底蕴，果然深不可测！”
除此之外，上官灼华还发现林潜身上有着一股难以言喻的气质，颇有一种老学究的意味，双眼更是深邃无比，仿佛能看穿人心一般。
“林师弟，你竟然突破到了真丹境中期了？”上官灼华脸上露出震惊，语气带着几分不确定。
她虽然感觉到林潜的强大气息，但是也只是怀疑，因此出声问道。
“哈哈，师弟前不久侥幸突破到了真丹境中期！”林潜谦虚的说道。
“啊！”一旁的小月闻言，不由的惊呼出声，但她很快意识到不对，一手捂着嘴巴，连忙收声，但是一双眼睛睁得大大的，盯着林潜。
不怪小月如此失态。

过去这么久了，她现在的修为才真元境六重巅峰，还没突破到真丹境。
当初她们与林潜同一批入门，林潜当时也是真元境修为，现在却已经是真丹境中期修为，境界已经超她太多了。
并且小月也明白一年多的时间，从真丹境初期突破到中期的含金量。
“两位请坐！”看到小月失态，林潜淡淡一笑，没有在意，而是招手让上官灼华、小月入座。
两人刚坐下，阿四便端着泡好的灵茶进来，给三人倒完茶后，又快步走了出去。
简单寒暄两句过后，上官灼华没有过多绕弯，直奔正题，目光直直的看向林潜。
“师弟此番历练归来，按理来说需要时间沉淀历练所获，师姐本不应该打扰林师弟的。”
上官灼华在得知林潜突破到真丹境中期后，猜测林潜应该是要花费时间来打磨、稳固境界，可她的这个任务，也确实需要林潜的帮助。
顿了顿，上官灼华继续说道：“但师姐接了一件任务，对我很重要，想要恳请林师弟出手相助。”
content_en:
Not long after, Ah Si led the two of them to the door of Chaoyang Hall, bowed and whispered: "My young master is in the hall, two senior sisters, please."
Ah Si made a gesture of invitation, but he didn't go in.
Shangguan Zhuohua nodded slightly and stepped into the hall.
Lin Qian had been waiting for a long time.
When Shangguan Zhuohua arrived at the foot of Chaoyang Peak, Lin Qian learned the news of Shangguan Zhuohua's arrival through a summons.
In the hall, Lin Qian was sitting quietly adjusting his breath. He heard footsteps and opened his eyes to look at the door.
A figure in a red robe as bright as fire stepped in, with a graceful figure and a peerless temperament.
After seeing the person coming clearly, Lin Qian stood up, showed a smile, clasped his fists and said, "Senior Sister Shangguan, you are welcome and well!"
Shangguan Zhuohua raised his eyes and looked at Lin Qian, his expression was stunned, but he was extremely shocked in his heart.
Not seen for more than a year, Lin Qian's aura became deeper and stronger, and he exuded the cultivation level of the middle stage of the true elixir realm.
"Junior Brother Lin's cultivation has improved so quickly, he is simply a monster!" Shangguan Zhuohua marveled in his heart.
It took her six or seven years to break through from the early stage of the True Alchemy Realm to the middle stage. This was even when she had no worries about resources.
But this Junior Brother Lin, in just over a year, has broken through from the early stage of the True Alchemy Realm to the middle stage of the True Alchemy Realm.
"Junior Brother Lin's talent and foundation are truly unfathomable!"
In addition, Shangguan Zhuohua also found that Lin Qian had an indescribable temperament, rather like an old scholar, and his eyes were extremely deep, as if he could see through people's hearts.
"Junior brother Lin, have you actually broken through to the middle stage of the true elixir realm?" Shangguan Zhuohua showed shock on his face, and his tone was a bit uncertain.
Although she felt Lin Qian's powerful aura, she was just suspicious, so she asked aloud.
"Haha, junior brother was lucky enough to break through to the middle stage of the true elixir realm not long ago!" Lin Qian said modestly.
"Ah!" Xiaoyue on the side couldn't help but exclaimed when she heard the words, but she quickly realized something was wrong, covered her mouth with one hand, and quickly stopped speaking, but her eyes were wide open, staring at Lin Qian.
Don't blame Xiaoyue for being so gloomy.
It has been so long, but her current cultivation level is only at the peak of the sixth level of the True Yuan Realm, and she has not yet broken through to the True Alchemy Realm.
They started in the same batch as Lin Qian. Lin Qian was also at the True Yuan realm at the time, but now he is at the middle stage of the True Elixir realm, and his realm has surpassed her by a lot.
And Xiaoyue also understands the value of more than a year to break through from the early stage of the true elixir realm to the middle stage.
"Please take a seat, both of you!" Seeing Xiaoyue's loss of composure, Lin Qian smiled lightly and did not care. Instead, he waved to Shangguan Zhuohua and Xiaoyue to take their seats.
As soon as the two sat down, Ah Si came in with the brewed spiritual tea. After pouring the tea for the three of them, he walked out quickly.
After a few simple greetings, Shangguan Zhuohua went straight to the topic without too many detours and looked straight at Lin Qian.
"Junior brother returns from this experience. Logically speaking, it takes time to accumulate what he has gained from the experience. Senior sister should not disturb Junior Brother Lin."
After Shangguan Zhuohua learned that Lin Qian had broken through to the middle stage of the true elixir realm, he guessed that Lin Qian needed to spend time polishing and stabilizing his realm, but she did need Lin Qian's help for this task.
After a pause, Shangguan Zhuohua continued: "But Senior Sister has taken over a task, which is very important to me, and I would like to ask Junior Brother Lin to help me."
